command_line:
set -eu
cat > analyze.R <<'RSCRIPT'
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, digits = 17)
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1L) stop("Expected one CSV input path")
input_path <- args[[1L]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))
d <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

required <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Replicate", "Area")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0L) stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))

d$StrainNumber <- trimws(as.character(d$StrainNumber))
d$Ratio <- trimws(as.character(d$Ratio))
d$Replicate <- trimws(as.character(d$Replicate))
d$Area <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d$Area)))
if (any(!is.finite(d$Area))) stop("Area contains non-finite values")

d$p287 <- NA_real_
is_mix <- d$StrainNumber == "287_98"
mix_parts <- strsplit(d$Ratio[is_mix], ":", fixed = TRUE)
if (length(mix_parts) > 0L) {
  if (any(lengths(mix_parts) != 2L)) stop("Mixture ratios must have exactly two components")
  a <- vapply(mix_parts, function(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[1L]])), numeric(1))
  b <- vapply(mix_parts, function(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[2L]])), numeric(1))
  if (any(!is.finite(a)) || any(!is.finite(b)) || any(a < 0) || any(b < 0) || any(a + b <= 0)) {
    stop("Invalid mixture ratio")
  }
  d$p287[is_mix] <- a / (a + b)
}
d$p287[d$StrainNumber == "98" & !is_mix] <- 0
d$p287[d$StrainNumber == "287" & !is_mix] <- 1

component_system <- d$StrainNumber %in% c("98", "287", "287_98")
if (any(!component_system & d$StrainNumber != "1")) {
  stop("Unexpected strain labels outside the 287_98 system")
}

primary <- d[component_system & is.finite(d$Area) & is.finite(d$p287), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(primary) != 42L) stop(paste("Unexpected primary row count:", nrow(primary)))
if (length(unique(primary$Replicate)) != 3L) stop("Unexpected replicate structure")
if (any(primary$p287 < 0 | primary$p287 > 1)) stop("Proportion outside [0,1]")
primary$p287 <- pmin(pmax(primary$p287, 0), 1)
interior <- primary[primary$StrainNumber == "287_98", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(interior) != 36L) stop(paste("Unexpected interior row count:", nrow(interior)))

make_optimum <- function(fit, dat, ngrid = 20001L) {
  domain <- range(dat$p287)
  grid <- seq(domain[[1L]], domain[[2L]], length.out = ngrid)
  grid_pred <- as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = grid)))
  if (any(!is.finite(grid_pred))) stop("Non-finite grid prediction")
  if (ngrid >= 3L) {
    local_idx <- which(
      grid_pred[2:(ngrid - 1L)] >= grid_pred[1:(ngrid - 2L)] &
      grid_pred[2:(ngrid - 1L)] >= grid_pred[3:ngrid]
    ) + 1L
  } else {
    local_idx <- integer(0L)
  }
  candidate_idx <- unique(c(1L, ngrid, local_idx))
  refine_one <- function(i) {
    if (i == 1L || i == ngrid) {
      return(c(p = grid[[i]], predicted_area = grid_pred[[i]]))
    }
    refined <- stats::optimize(
      f = function(x) as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = x))),
      interval = c(grid[[i - 1L]], grid[[i + 1L]]),
      maximum = TRUE
    )
    c(p = refined$maximum, predicted_area = refined$objective)
  }
  candidates <- do.call(rbind, lapply(candidate_idx, refine_one))
  best <- candidates[which.max(candidates[, "predicted_area"]), ]
  c(
    optimum_frequency = as.numeric(best[["p"]]),
    predicted_area = as.numeric(best[["predicted_area"]]),
    domain_min = domain[[1L]],
    domain_max = domain[[2L]]
  )
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope_name) {
  formulas <- list(
    quadratic = Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2),
    cubic = Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2) + I(p287^3),
    natural_spline_df4 = Area ~ splines::ns(p287, df = 4)
  )
  comparison_rows <- list()
  optimum_rows <- list()
  for (model_name in names(formulas)) {
    fit <- stats::lm(formulas[[model_name]], data = dat)
    fit_summary <- summary(fit)
    opt <- make_optimum(fit, dat)
    comparison_rows[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nobs(fit),
      parameters = length(stats::coef(fit)),
      aic = as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit)),
      bic = as.numeric(stats::BIC(fit)),
      r_squared = as.numeric(fit_summary$r.squared),
      adjusted_r_squared = as.numeric(fit_summary$adj.r.squared),
      rss = as.numeric(deviance(fit)),
      optimum_frequency = opt[["optimum_frequency"]],
      predicted_area = opt[["predicted_area"]],
      domain_min = opt[["domain_min"]],
      domain_max = opt[["domain_max"]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    optimum_rows[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nobs(fit),
      aic = as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit)),
      optimum_frequency = opt[["optimum_frequency"]],
      predicted_area = opt[["predicted_area"]],
      domain_min = opt[["domain_min"]],
      domain_max = opt[["domain_max"]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  comparison <- do.call(rbind, comparison_rows)
  optimums <- do.call(rbind, optimum_rows)
  comparison$selected_by_aic <- comparison$model == comparison$model[which.min(comparison$aic)]
  optimums$selected_by_aic <- optimums$model == optimums$model[which.min(optimums$aic)]
  list(comparison = comparison, optimums = optimums)
}

primary_fit <- fit_scope(primary, "primary_full_boundaries")
interior_fit <- fit_scope(interior, "interior_mixtures_only")
comparison <- rbind(primary_fit$comparison, interior_fit$comparison)
optimums <- rbind(primary_fit$optimums, interior_fit$optimums)

primary_selected <- primary_fit$optimums[which.min(primary_fit$optimums$aic), , drop = FALSE]
primary_selected$selection_metric <- "minimum_AIC"
primary_selected$selection_scope <- "primary_full_boundaries"
primary_selected <- primary_selected[, c(
  "selection_scope", "selection_metric", "model", "n", "aic",
  "optimum_frequency", "predicted_area", "domain_min", "domain_max"
), drop = FALSE]

utils::write.table(
  comparison,
  file = "model_comparison.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(
  optimums,
  file = "model_optima.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(
  primary_selected,
  file = "optimal_prediction.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
